# Crawlhound

> Read-only web spider skill for Claude Code (v0.3.0). Crawls the data you choose (a JSON schema written from a plain-English ask, or a preset: text, tables, links, prices, product, article) from static and JavaScript sites, and maps pages, SPA states, routes, forms and GET APIs. robots.txt and 1 request per second; every non-GET/HEAD request is blocked in the browser.

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add maumoya/crawlhound` then `/plugin install crawlhound@crawlhound`
- Any agent: `npx skills add maumoya/crawlhound`
- GitHub Action: `uses: maumoya/crawlhound@v0.3.0` with `url`, optional `extract`, `min-pages`, `min-items`

## Files

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/maumoya/crawlhound/blob/main/skills/crawlhound/SKILL.md): the skill
- [schema.md](https://github.com/maumoya/crawlhound/blob/main/skills/crawlhound/references/schema.md): the extraction schema format
- [README.md](https://github.com/maumoya/crawlhound/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, benchmark results
- [bench/](https://github.com/maumoya/crawlhound/tree/main/bench): reproducible benchmark against Crawlee, Crawl4AI, Scrapy, Katana and Firecrawl
